_comment: config_mixed.json + map_order plr (Prioritized Level Replay within each stage; curriculum/scheduler.py docstring has the exact rule). plr.rho: share of the staleness distribution (keeps every map visited); plr.beta: rank temperature, P_S ~ (1/rank)^(1/beta), lower = sharper; plr.window: outcomes per map in the failure score (1 - mean success); plr.progress_weight: weight of |mean(last window) - mean(window before)| (0 = off; 0.5 measured in simulation to let one map take about half a stage's draws). Enable with DOOMSDAY_CURRICULUM_CONFIG=curriculum/config_mixed_plr.json. Training only.
